qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Rejected – G1 Understandability). Newly listed on Euronext Amsterdam in January 2026 with no public multi-cycle operating history; complex holding structure built via rapid debt-funded defense rollups across Central Europe and the US, with key operational risks—including undisclosed NATO procurement suspensions at its Spanish subsidiary and ongoing state contract corruption probes—invisible from reported financials.
qualitative.evidence: Czechoslovak Group (CSG N.V.) debuted on Euronext Amsterdam in January 2026, lacking any public multi-cycle operating record. Employs an aggressive acquisition rollup strategy (The Kinetic Group, Fiocchi). Faces severe transparency and governance concerns: NATO NSPA quietly suspended subsidiary Fábrica de Municiones de Granada (FMG) in July 2025 (undisclosed at IPO), and state consulting payments to Slovakia's defense minister triggered public anti-corruption inquiries.
